$comment: Canonical manifest for the Brixter agent skills. Each entry's SKILL.md is agent-neutral markdown; the metadata here is what per-agent adapters need and SKILL.md frontmatter cannot carry portably (activation globs, ordering). Keep `name`/`description` in sync with the SKILL.md frontmatter.

skills.name: brixter-site
skills.description: Build or extend a Brixter-compatible marketing site in SvelteKit — install and configure the Vite plugin, lay out the $lib/brixter directories, decide what becomes a brik vs a page prop, and wire theming, SEO and the sitemap.

skills.name: brixter-brik
skills.description: Author or edit a .brix file — the template of a reusable Brixter section, including {interpolation}, {#each}, {#if}, the @tag annotations that type a prop, and the ?? fallback that doubles as its editor placeholder.

skills.name: brixter-page
skills.description: Author or edit a +page.md — routing, the brix list and its props, the metadata block that drives <head>, the markdown body handed to the layout, per-page sitemap control, and redirects via aliases.

skills.name: brixter-controller
skills.description: Add interactivity to a Brixter site by writing a controller — the vanilla JS/TS module that progressively enhances .brix markup, its init/cleanup signature, auto-registration, and lifecycle wiring.
